command: node --import apps/desktop/scripts/test-env.mjs --import apps/desktop/scripts/test-tsx.mjs benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/record-phone-worktree.mjs --tree <git archive of b6f10295a2f698afc85332467192de28500bd146 with node_modules>

entry.notRun: the relay transport (encryption, admission) and the window process; the daemon runs without memory worker and MCP servers (MIXDOG_DAEMON_SKIP_MEMORY, MIXDOG_DISABLE_MCP), with the supervisor binary the real-turn harness cached
entry.runs: executeRemoteFrame over createRemoteMethods (remote-methods.ts:828, :1256) with SessionHost (session-host.ts) attached to the tree's own daemon (session-client.mjs ensureDaemon, attachSession; session-protocol.mjs createSessionProtocolClient), one world and one daemon per group

normalized.control: the host's control session's id (the snapshot a call naming no session carries) is <control> (each product makes its own)
normalized.pid: clientHostPid is <pid> (the id of the process hosting the session runtime)
normalized.session: the session's own id is <session> in every answer (each product makes its own)
normalized.setupChanged: a call's snapshot leaves out setupChanged: Node hands the settings_changed notice to the session asynchronously (notification-router.mjs:33-36), so which answer first carries it, and its seq, differ between two recordings of this recorder; each group ends with one `settled` entry, the control (and project) session's setupChanged once it holds still, compared whole
normalized.time: a field named *At or at is <time> (the run time)
normalized.tx: a workspace transition's txId is <tx> (a random id each run makes)

notRecorded.notProducible: a request that is no object, names no or an unknown capability, has args that are no array, or a session id that is no id: the page's invokeCapability always sends {capability, args, sessionId?} with a capability it names and a session id it holds, and those requests go to the group that owns invokeCapability itself

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

settledStatus.core: has the settled values from the start (only faster with the same content, rule U-SV1); a change of these values later in a session (a model switch) is content, recorded as its own case
settledStatus.node: Node fills these on its session status pass (local-session-runtime.mjs createRuntimePulse: syncContextStats, then routeState, context-state.mjs:45-155; agentStatusState, agent-tool-routing.mjs:51-66), which its daemon's status scheduler runs when a mark arrives (session-status-scheduler.mjs); before the first pass they are null/0, after the first the route's window with the display fields 0, from the second on the settled values; agentScope is null until the keychain prewarm is done (agent-tool.mjs statusFor). A projection Node drops after 90 s idle is rebuilt with them empty until the next pass (retention.mjs:127-143). Which of these a call answered depended on whether a pass had landed
settledStatus.recording: holds the settled state: before every case the daemon's scheduler runs on a virtual clock the recorder moves (beforeEachCase in golden.json: status-clock-preload.mjs, the keychain prewarm awaited, then three marks of every session each followed by 1 s), no real wait; the idle projection drop and eviction are set beyond a run (MIXDOG_SESSION_PROJECTION_IDLE_MS, MIXDOG_SESSION_IDLE_EVICT_MS)

syntheticInput.world: a git repository registered as a Project (main, feature, spare; the review group leaves a.txt changed), a folder that is no Project, and one idle project session created as the new task does (session.create {cwd, desktopSession}); fixed git identity and time for every commit
